title: Programmable Manufacturing
purpose: Use ComputerCraft monitoring and programmable production to reduce downtime and manual scheduling.
optimization_opportunities: Maintain buffers, detect shortages before stalls, monitor power, and parallelize slow physical processes.
infrastructure_reuse: The physical factory remains intact; ComputerCraft adds supervision and scheduling rather than replacing machines.

milestones.title: Computer Online
final_validation: Boot a ComputerCraft computer and save a working factory-control program.

milestones.title: Factory Telemetry
final_validation: Monitor energy storage, one machine, and a fuel or fluid tank.

milestones.title: Electric Fabricator
milestones.temporary_validation: Obtain the clearly labeled test placeholder. Final validation requires an EU-powered 160-tick fixed-recipe fabricator.

milestones.title: Programmable Assembler
milestones.temporary_validation: Obtain the clearly labeled test placeholder. Final validation requires a multi-program ComputerCraft-controlled assembler.

milestones.title: Queued Production Order
final_validation: Queue a production order and report progress and missing ingredients.
milestones.temporary_validation: Manual-check the storyboard behavior until the assembler peripheral exists.

milestones.title: Automated Multi-Step Manufacturing
final_validation: Complete a multi-step product with automatic routing, monitored buffers, and no routine hand-crafting.
milestones.temporary_validation: Manual-check the physical line and document its inputs and outputs.

milestones.title: Programmable Manufacturing
final_validation: Operate monitored, queued production that can identify shortages and recover from replenishment.
milestones.temporary_validation: Manual-check the combined system until final peripheral APIs exist.
